title: Clock
description: x-clock shows the current time in the element and updates it every second. It shows US Central time unless timezone says otherwise.

variant.description: Clock face: `digital` (bold, default), `led` (green seven-segment) or `analog` (the same time text, not bold -- there is no dial; `analogue` is accepted). Any other value renders `digital` and logs a warning naming these three.

format.description: `24` (default) or `12` for a 12-hour clock with AM/PM.

showSeconds.description: Show the seconds field. On unless set to `"false"`.

timezone.description: The time zone the clock shows: an IANA name such as `America/New_York`, or `local` for the visitor's own. Defaults to US Central (`America/Chicago`, CDT/CST). An unknown name logs a warning and shows Central.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
